claims.sentence: The hypothesis that treatment of krill oil (KO), which contains DHA/eicosapentaenoic acid (EPA) at the SN2 position of phosphatidylcholine, with SN1‐specific lipase will generate LPC‐DHA/EPA and which can be absorbed intact and transported into the brain, is tested.</jats:p></jats:sec><jats:sec><jats:title>Methods</jats:title><jats:p>KO and fish oil (FO) are treated with <jats:italic>Mucor meihei</jats:italic> lipase, incorporated into AIN 93G diet, and fed to 2‐month‐old mice for 30 days.
